scenes.title: p-i-m-a
scenes.subtitle: Arpeggios with thumb and fingers.
lines: This lesson teaches arpeggios using your thumb and fingers — p-i-m-a.
We'll play one at a time, starting with the thumb.

scenes.heading: Thumb and fingers
lines: Your thumb (p) plays bass strings 6, 5 and 4 by pushing down through the string.
Your index (i), middle (m) and ring (a) fingers pluck strings 3, 2 and 1 with the fingertips toward your palm.
Rest your hand lightly, and let each note ring clearly.

scenes.title: Am arpeggio
lines: Hold the Am shape and pick p-i-m-a-m-i across strings 5, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3.

scenes.title: C arpeggio
lines: Hold the C chord and play the pattern: fifth string third fret, third string open, second string first fret, and first string open.
Let the app listen as you play p-i-m-a.
Rest your hand, let the notes ring, and find your sound.
